name: Chinese (Mandarin, pinyin)
caution: Mandarin pseudowords are sequences of real toned syllables that do not form a word, so the unit here is the toned syllable (1,187 of them, about 400 base syllables × tones), written in pinyin. Length, neighbours (one syllable substituted, added or removed) and the n-gram models all work on syllables, not letters. CV is the orthographic CV of the pinyin letters of each syllable in turn (zh/ch/sh and ng count as one C; y and w as C; every vowel letter as V): zhōng = CVC, xiǎo = CVVV. Pinyin from pypinyin; 不 and 一 carry their citation tones; the neutral tone is written without a mark.

english_contamination_removed.rule: Leipzig-only words of 5+ letters that are English words with Zipf >= 4.5

fields.zipf: Zipf of the syllable's token frequency summed over all words containing it
fields.homophones: distinct characters read with this toned syllable in reference-eligible words
fields.gap: tonal gap: legal syllable with a tone it never carries (no morpheme); not in any word
fields.rare: reading seen in fewer than 3 reference-eligible words: accepted as input, never generated

symbols.source: pypinyin (MIT) over the FILMS zh_CN subtitle word list; 不 and 一 with citation tones; neutral tone = 5, shown without a mark

reference_lexicon: plain words (alphabet only) with Zipf >= 2.0 and corpus count >= 3

generators.gap: tonal gap (syllable with an unattested tone) alone or with a real syllable

model.trigram_variants: plain maximum-likelihood letter trigrams with two start markers and one end marker; type counts (each word once) or token counts (each word weighted by its per-million frequency)

filters.not_a_corpus_form: rejected if it occurs anywhere in the corpus word list
filters.phonotactic_legality: initial, medial and final consonant clusters and vowel sequences must each occur in >= 3 reference words

metrics.old20: mean Levenshtein distance to the 20 closest reference words
metrics.logprob: mean log2 probability per letter (incl. word end); model = generating model, all = all-words model

generation.target_rule: per generator and training set: number of training words, between 5000 and 40000
